title: Choose the visual world
question: The site must still read as a Knowledge Panel (name, descriptor, portrait, fact cards) — never a fake Google page. The roll built that grammar out of a DC Books jacket table. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Jacket Table
options.lineage: DC Books cover stock at a Kerala book-fair table
options.thesis: O.P. Suresh is discovered the way a book is: a Knowledge Panel printed as jackets, not a poet on cream paper and not a Google clone.
options.viewport: Saturated DC yellow field. Huge cover-title 'O.P. Suresh'. Publisher line 'Malayalam poet, songwriter, translator'. Portrait as a jacket photo. Books / awards / Kerala as smaller stacked jackets.
options.risk: Yellow can read as marketplace chrome if the type is not as grave as a jacket spine.

options.label: Page 100
options.thesis: His public graph is a keyed magazine: identity on page 100, books on 200, awards on 300, Malayalam titles waiting behind REVEAL.
options.viewport: Black 40-column screen. Double-height yellow 'O.P. SURESH'. Cyan facts for Akademi 2020 and Cheekode. A 100/200/300 page header. REVEAL hint for താജ്മഹൽ.
options.case: Wins clarity for a knowledge graph; loses identification — literary readers will not see themselves in Ceefax.
options.risk: A retro tech demo that forgets he is a poet.

options.label: One Block
options.thesis: One gouged sheet is the panel: name and face cut from black; each book is the next demand, not a card in a grid.
options.viewport: Cheap manila field. Monumental black figure cropped from below. Irregular carved caps 'O.P. Suresh'. A single carved line of awards under the fist of the portrait.
options.case: Wins identification with Kerala's political print shop; loses catalog clarity — one demand per sheet hides the books Google needs to list.
options.risk: Strike-poster heat overstates a lyric poet.

options.label: Shadow Stall
options.thesis: Poems as stalls of borrowed light — a night lane of titles tagged by origin and length.
options.viewport: Blue-black lane. A stall sign 'O.P. Suresh'. Shadow-goods labeled as book titles. Moon-white edge on the active stall.
options.case: Fuses poorly: this product is sourced facts for search, not tradable shadows. Mood without a Person graph.
options.risk: Beautiful and unclaimable — Google cannot ingest a bazaar.

canonCard.label: Play it straight
canonCard.thesis: A conventional poet homepage: name, portrait, About, Books, Awards, Contact — cream paper, literary serif, no invented grammar.
canonCard.viewport: Cream page. Centered name. Subtitle poet/translator. Circular portrait. Nav: About / Books / Contact.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from a hundred other writer sites; weaker as a Knowledge Panel analogue.
